label: Motion Tracking
description: Allows for enabling/disabling motion tracking, typically supported by PTZ Cameras

enabledTargets.label: Enabled Targets
enabledTargets.description: List of target types motion tracking is enabled for.

supportedTargets.label: Supported Targets
supportedTargets.description: List of target types supported by the device for motion tracking

setTrackingTargets.label: Set Tracking Targets
setTrackingTargets.description:
Sets the enabled targets for Motion Tracking.
Enables Motion Tracking only for the given target types, thereby disabling it for the rest

targetTypes.description: List of target types motion tracking should be enabled for.
